_comment: Everything you control lives here. The code knows nothing about specific roles — edit this file, not src/.

_hints.searches: Add as many as you like. `keywords` drive both remote-feed filtering and the search box on query sources.
_hints.employmentTypes: Empty array = any. Put e.g. ["internship"] or ["ojt"] to narrow. Matched loosely against each posting's type/title.
_hints.remoteOnly: false lets on-site roles through (mainly affects the PH sources).
_hints.excludeKeywords: Any job whose title or description contains one of these is dropped.
_hints.minSalary: Number in USD-ish terms, or null. Jobs with no parseable salary are always kept.
_hints.postedWithinDays: null = no age limit. Jobs with no date are always kept.
_hints.perSource: Cap on jobs taken from any single source per run.
_hints.fetchDescriptions: OnlineJobs.PH needs one extra request per job to get its description. Set false to run faster with thinner data.
_hints.requestDelayMs: Politeness delay between requests to the same host.
